question: According to Census of India 2011, in which of the following Union Territories was the sex ratio recorded at 1037 females per 1000 males?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Puducherry**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **Census of India 2011**, the **Puducherry **recorded a **sex ratio of 1037 females per 1000 males**, one of the highest among the **Union Territories of India**.
 
• A sex ratio above 1000 indicates that there are more females than males in the population of the region.
 
• The high sex ratio in this region can be attributed to factors like **better health conditions, lower gender-based discrimination, and smaller population size**.
 
• The region also has a significant **tribal population**, where traditional practices may contribute to a more balanced or higher sex ratio.
 
• This data from the **2011 Census** highlights the importance of improving gender equality and ensuring women's well-being in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Chandigarh**__

 __
 
• **Chandigarh** is a Union Territory and the joint capital of **Punjab and Haryana**.
 
• It has a relatively low sex ratio due to **urbanization and socio-economic factors**.
 
 
 
• **Lakshadweep**__
 
 
• **Lakshadweep** is an archipelago of 36 islands located in the **Arabian Sea**.
 
• The **sex ratio** here is high but not as high as that of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
 
• It is known for its **unique ecosystem, coral reefs, and marine life**.
